Rescue parses all fail: (i) past-participle reduced relative on 'subject matter' would be passive and cannot take the direct object 'a disquieting atmosphere'; (ii) finite past 'created' parallel to present-tense 'work' fails for tense and lacks a conjunction; (iii) no overt subject, so no absolute construction.
